engine: Valhalla, auto costing, on the FOSSGIS public server. These settings are for live estimates only (pins with no saved result); saved results come from our routing server (data/drive/).
benchmark: Google Maps predicted school-day drive times (30 homes per measured site, data/drive_measurements.json), fit to the public server's times for the same homes. Each region's cut-off is the median of its measured sites; the range spans all of them.

5.basis: median of 8 measured Florida sites (public-server times); range = all of them (2026-11-12)

rangeModel.basis: scripts/qa_drive_accuracy.ts --write-range-model, 2026-11-12: measured from paired checks on independent Google samples (Florida 2026-11-10, 5 sites, drop-off; New Jersey 2026-11-11, 6 campuses, both directions), estimates from leave-one-site-out.

countScale.basis: scripts/qa_drive_accuracy.ts, 2026-11-12: Google's count over our fitted line's, on independent samples (paired, DerSimonian-Laird), applied where it differs from 1 at 90%.
